svg.text: End-to-End Workflow: Approved Packages to an Air-Gapped Fleet
detector can ENCRYPT only; SNS review link
Fargate sync downloads ONLY approved NEVRAs
Additive write to frozen S3, replace repodata
cross-account read (mirror task role, KMS decrypt)
Mirror serves S3 over internal HTTPS
nginx + sigv4, internal ALB, 3 Fargate tasks
Image Builder bakes AMIs from the mirror
Patch Manager patches fleet from the mirror
ONLY to the frozen mirror, no fallback
No unreviewed package ever reaches production
Reproducible AMIs: same frozen state = same image
No package drift: install, upgrade, patch from one snapshot
Full audit: manifest history + signed approval + CloudTrail
Icons: AWS Architecture Icons. Steps 1 to 8 run monthly in the connected account; 9 to 12 are the continuous air-gapped read path.
